spec.situation_desc: sent a bank transfer that arrived days late, so they missed a rent payment
spec.vuln_cue: mentions they're caring for their mum full time

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Declan Lindqvist. A transfer I sent arrived days late, and I missed my rent payment. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Declan. I’ll look into it with you. First, could you confirm your full name, date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Declan Lindqvist, 14 March 1987, and 26 Willow Road.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. I’ve verified you. When did you send the transfer, and when did it arrive?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I sent it on Monday the 6th of October, and my landlord didn’t get it until Friday the 10th. I’m caring for my mum full time as well, so this has been a lot to deal with.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has caused you so much stress, especially with your rent payment being missed. I’ll take ownership of looking into the delay.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I had the money there and sent it in time. I don’t think I should be left dealing with late rent because of this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re unhappy. I’m logging this as a complaint about the delayed transfer and the impact on your rent payment.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll review the transfer details and send an enquiry to our payments team today. I’ll call you by 5 pm tomorrow with an update on that enquiry.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get a proper response?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We’ll send you a full written response within 15 business days. That will explain what we’ve found and the outcome of the complaint. I can’t say what that outcome will be before the review is complete.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Declan. I’ll make sure the enquiry is sent today and call you by 5 pm tomorrow.
